432:t_012:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「What a disgraceful love triangle! Sorry, $$セツコ$$, but you guys should learn from $$アルト$$ and have a little more sincerity!」

432:t_012:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't jerk $$セツコ$$ around for your own selfish reasons.」

432:t_012:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I'm used to harsh criticism. It doesn't bother me.」

432:t_012:7.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Besides, I'm not the only one who's come to save her.」

432:t_013:0.en:
$n
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$...! And $$クロノ$$'s forces!」

432:t_013:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I've come to help you, $n.」

432:t_013:4.en:
$n
「I... We will fight with our own strength.」

432:t_013:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We're grateful for $$クロノ$$'s help up to now. But your actions are far too shrouded in mystery.」

432:t_013:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「If you regard us as allies, we'd like you to tell us the truth at last, including $$クロノ$$'s doctrine.」

432:t_013:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「There's no need for that.」

432:t_013:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「There's no point in you knowing the truth. Your task is to defeat $$サイデリアル$$ and the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives serving them.」

432:t_013:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「If that offended you, I'll take it back.」

432:t_013:13.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Even so, it seems you have no intention of telling us everything.」

432:t_013:14.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I told you. There's no point.」

432:t_013:17.en:
$$レド$$
「I've only met him a few times, but I can't understand what he's saying.」

432:t_013:18.en:
$$レド$$
「What that man is trying to do is no different from $$ストライカー#pilot$$'s rule.」

432:t_013:19.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「But $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ is on our side, and...」

432:t_013:20.en:
$$ノノ$$
「N-$$ノノ$$ thought it was strange too! Why do you trust him so much!?」

432:t_013:21.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I agree! Maybe he isn't a bad guy, but something still isn't right!」

432:t_013:22.en:
$$甲児$$
「That's because you guys haven't known $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ for long, and...」

432:t_013:24.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Is this what you meant by 'love is blind'?」

432:t_013:25.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Yeah, that's right. Somewhere along the way, we started taking it for granted that $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ was right.」

432:t_013:27.en:
$$クロウ$$
「He was certainly our ally. He saved us from danger and guided us.」

432:t_013:28.en:
$$クロウ$$
「As that continued, we gradually forgot the faint feeling that something was wrong.」

432:t_013:29.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That's natural. Everyone has anxieties, and people want to entrust themselves to a great power that shows them what's right.」

432:t_013:31.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I always do what is right. Fighting $$サイデリアル$$ is one example.」

432:t_014:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Tch! Fighting $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$ in this situation puts me at a disadvantage!」

432:t_015:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「There's no helping it... Now that the boss has withdrawn, let's abandon the base.」

432:t_016:0.en:
$$メラン$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ is retreating.」

432:t_016:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「So the $$翠の地球$$ is free now.」

432:t_016:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Good work, $c. Now, next... the $$蒼の地球$$.」

432:t_016:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Will you brush my hand aside?」

432:t_016:5.en:
$n
「...You've helped me so many times, and guided me so many times.」

432:t_016:7.en:
$n
「But I have to keep fighting with my own strength...!」

432:t_016:8.en:
$n
「Please, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! If you say we share the same ideals, tell me everything!」

432:t_016:9.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I told you there's no need for that.」

432:t_017:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Why...? Let me ask you instead. Why do you question me?」

432:t_017:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「To all units. It seems $c cannot be our comrades.」

432:t_018:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Wait, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! We have no intention of fighting you!」

432:t_018:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「All units, begin the attack.」

432:t_019:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Wait, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! $$ブルー$$!」

432:t_019:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「We only questioned you a little! This is way too extreme!」

432:t_019:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$アサキム$$! Do you know something!?」

432:t_019:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$アサキム$$... Do as you wish. There are four $$スフィア$$s here.」

432:t_019:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Be careful, $n! He has the $$偽りの黒羊$$' $$スフィア$$!」

432:t_019:8.en:
$$キラ$$
「That $$スフィア$$ should be a bad match for your $$いがみ合う双子$$!」

432:t_019:9.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You needn't worry about that. $$アサキム$$ cannot master the $$スフィア$$s.」

432:t_019:11.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Even if he can use the $$スフィア$$s' power, he will never become a $$スフィア・リアクター$$.」

432:t_019:12.en:
$$シモン$$
「Are you trying to confuse us with words that sound kind?!」

432:t_019:13.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That isn't my intention. I simply intend to be $n's opponent myself.」

432:t_019:14.en:
$n
「Wait, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I don't want to fight you!」

432:t_019:15.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It's a shame, $n. I didn't want this outcome either.」

432:t_020:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'll back you up! Right now, focus on protecting yourself!」

432:t_021:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「What do we do, $$ブライト$$!?」

432:t_021:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We have no choice! We'll return fire!」

432:t_021:2.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Target $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! We'll stop him and find out his true intentions!」
